title: REQ · Manifest loader validates references and reports missing assets without crashing
summary: Loader returns validation errors, dangling references and missing-asset fallbacks
description: Context: no manifest loader exists. Desired behavior: loadManifest validates data, checks every object asset reference exists in the manifest (dangling) and every manifest path exists via an injected exists function, returning a report and fallback entries instead of throwing. Why: missing assets must not crash the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manifest whose file is missing, When loaded, Then report.missing lists its id and the call does not throw
Given an object referencing an unknown asset id, When loaded, Then report.dangling lists it
Given invalid manifest data, When loaded, Then report.errors is non-empty and no exception propagates
Given a missing asset, When resolving it, Then the fallback entry is returned
technical_constraints: Filesystem access via injected exists function
